title: Quick's prothrombin time as plasma is diluted, 1935
description: Bar chart. Clotting time of normal human plasma with excess thromboplastin and calcium as it is diluted with salt solution: undiluted 23 seconds, 80 per cent plasma 30, 60 per cent 35, 40 per cent 45, 20 per cent 65. Data: Quick, Stanley-Brown and Bancroft 1935, table 2.
heading: QUICK 1935 · CLOTTING TIME AS PLASMA IS DILUTED
